dict.string: SpaceJudge only reads the names and sizes of items in a folder you choose (such as Desktop) to draw a space map. It does not read regular file contents, never changes or deletes files, and does not upload data by default. If you choose analysis in Codex, selected item names, sizes, optional exact target path and scan metadata are handed to the Codex desktop app as a draft. You decide whether to send it there.
